_note: Life events. Each arrives as a call, text or moment in the dressing room, with choices that cost something. Effects: honour, manager, teammates, fans, family, money, energy, slot (uses a time slot this week), flag (remembered), unflag. 'next' queues a follow-up {id, in: weeks, chance}. 'news' puts a story in Monday's paper: page front|back, headline with {NAME}. Conditions: minWeek, notPreseason, needFlag, notFlag, meter minimums (min) / maximums (max), contract types (types), weight. Design rule: the bad choice is always tempting.

events.text: Mate. Overslept. Again. If the gaffer asks, tell him I was with you at the physio. You're a legend. Owe you one. Gaz

choices.label: Cover for him
choices.result: Gaz owes you one. Gaz has owed everyone one since 2019.

choices.label: Tell him to sort himself out
choices.result: Gaz calls you a grass in the group chat. Then sends a sad face.

events.text: Funny thing, son. The physio was in Tenerife last Tuesday. So where were you and Gaz? Think carefully. I can smell a lie like a three-day-old mackerel.

choices.label: Come clean
choices.result: The gaffer nods slowly. Gaz runs laps until his legs are spaghetti.

choices.label: Double down on the lie
choices.result: The gaffer's eyes narrow. You've been dropped into his bad books, and the bad books are wet.

events.text: Quick one, pet. Are you starting Saturday? Only Maureen at bingo reckons you're on the bench and there's good money riding on it. Just a little nod. Nobody would know.

choices.label: Give her a little nod
choices.result: Gran makes a noise like a kettle. 'You're a good boy.'

choices.label: Gran, I can't tell you that
choices.result: 'Your grandad would've told me,' she says. Your grandad was banned from three bookmakers.

events.text: They've BANNED me from the bookies! Said my bets were 'statistically improbable'. I said I'm just lucky. They've sent a letter to the FA. Is that bad?

choices.label: Ring the FA and explain
choices.result: A tired man at the FA writes 'GRAN' on a Post-it and sighs.

news.headline: GRANNY GAMBLE: {NAME}'S NAN IN BETTING BAN

choices.label: Lie low and hope it goes away
choices.result: It doesn't go away. It never goes away.

events.text: Hi! We'd love you to visit the children's ward on Thursday. Bring a smile and some signed photos. (Gaz says the lads are going to Wetherspoons that night. Ignore Gaz.)

choices.label: Visit the hospital (uses a time slot)
choices.result: A seven-year-old beats you at FIFA and tells you you're rubbish. Best afternoon of your life.

news.headline: HEARTS OF GOLD: {NAME} CHEERS SICK KIDS

choices.label: Go out with the lads
choices.result: Somebody orders a round of Jägerbombs at 6pm. It's a long night.

events.text: Sid Scoop, Weekly Splash. I've got a photo of you asleep in a kebab shop wearing a traffic cone. Any comment before we go to print?

choices.label: 'It was a fancy dress thing'
choices.result: It was not a fancy dress thing.

choices.label: Apologise to the club
choices.result: The gaffer accepts. He's seen worse. He did worse.

news.headline: SORRY SEEMS TO BE THE HARDEST WORD FOR CONE-HEAD {NAME}

events.text: You're live on Radio Bantam's Football Phone-In! Caller from Dudley says the gaffer's tactics are 'like watching paint dry, but the paint's also asleep'. Do you agree?

choices.label: Back the gaffer
choices.result: The gaffer texts you a single fish emoji. High praise.

choices.label: 'He's got a point, to be fair'
choices.result: The phone-in lines light up. So does the gaffer's face.

choices.label: Talk about fishing for ten minutes
choices.result: The presenter cuts to the travel news. The gaffer loved it.

events.text: It's my birthday dinner Wednesday love. Your auntie Carol's coming. She's bringing the trifle. Please come. The coach mentioned extra shooting practice though didn't he?

choices.label: Go to Mum's dinner (uses a time slot)
choices.result: Auntie Carol's trifle is 40% sherry. Mum cries twice. Lovely evening.

choices.label: Stay for extra shooting
choices.result: Mum says it's fine. It is not fine. Auntie Carol posts about it on Facebook.

events.text: Initiation night. Everyone's chanting your name. You have to stand on a chair and sing. The senior pros are watching. Gaz is filming.

choices.label: Belt out Mr Brightside
choices.result: You miss every high note. The dressing room goes wild. Gaz's video gets 40 views, all Gaz.

choices.label: Refuse, you're not a performing seal
choices.result: Silence. Someone fills your boots with yoghurt the next morning.

events.text: Hi, Nikey Sports here (not that one). We'll give you £600 to wear our boots. They're nearly leather. The swoosh goes the other way. Interested?

choices.label: Take the £600
choices.result: The boots squeak. Every step sounds like a duck being sat on.

news.headline: JUST DON'T DO IT: {NAME}'S KNOCK-OFF BOOT DEAL

choices.label: No thanks
choices.result: 'Your loss,' they text. Then: 'Would you do it for £400?'

events.text: You're in the big Tesco in your pyjama bottoms buying Coco Pops when a fan spots you. 'Can I get a selfie? And can you do a video for my brother? He hates you.'

choices.label: Smile, selfie, video, the lot
choices.result: The brother still hates you, but he hates you a bit less.

choices.label: Pretend you're someone else
choices.result: 'You're definitely him,' she says. 'You've got his face.'

news.headline: PYJAMA DRAMA: {NAME} SNUBS FAN IN CEREAL AISLE

events.text: Son. I'm going down the reservoir Sunday. Dawn start. Bring a flask. Don't tell the others, they'll want to come and they fish like idiots.

choices.label: Go fishing with the gaffer (uses a time slot)
choices.result: Six hours. One fish. He names it after you. It's the happiest you've ever seen him.

choices.label: Make an excuse
choices.result: 'Suit yourself,' he says, in the voice of a man who will remember this.

events.text: Big Terry, club captain, 34, has taken your peg, your towel and your protein shake. 'Rookies get the corner by the bin,' he says. The lads are watching.

choices.label: Stand up to him
choices.result: Big Terry stares at you for a long time. Then he laughs and gives you the towel back. The shake's gone though.

choices.label: Corner by the bin it is
choices.result: It's not too bad by the bin. You get to know the bin quite well.

events.text: Oi superstar. The Red Lion are in the cup final Sunday and we're short. Come on, one game, for old times. Ref's blind. Pitch is a swamp. You'll love it.

choices.label: Play for the Red Lion (uses a time slot)
choices.result: You score a hat-trick in wellies. Deano cries. You're banned from the Red Lion's car park for life (long story).

choices.label: Can't risk the injury, sorry
choices.result: Deano sends a voice note. It's just him saying 'Big time Charlie' for forty seconds.

events.text: Someone's sent me a video of you in a Red Lion shirt, on a swamp, doing a knee slide into a dog. Explain.

choices.label: 'It was for charity'
choices.result: 'Which charity?' 'The Red Lion.' Long silence.

news.headline: PUB-LIC ENEMY: {NAME} RISKS IT ALL IN SUNDAY LEAGUE

choices.label: Hold your hands up
choices.result: He fines you a week's tea money. Fair.

events.text: Bro can I borrow £500. Car's failed its MOT and I need it for, er, a car thing. Pay you back next week 100%. Kev

choices.label: Lend him £500
choices.result: Kev hugs you so hard your back clicks.

choices.label: Sorry Kev, skint
choices.result: Kev says no worries. Kev is very worried.

events.text: Told you bro! £500 back plus a Twix for interest. Legend.

choices.label: Accept the Twix
choices.result: Best interest rate you'll ever get.

events.text: The prank war's escalated. Somebody's put cling film over the gaffer's toilet. Everyone thinks it was you. It wasn't. Was it?

choices.label: Go bigger: fill Gaz's car with balloons
choices.result: Four hundred balloons. Gaz opens the door and becomes a viral sensation.

choices.label: Stay well out of it
choices.result: You eat your lunch alone, but with dignity.

events.text: Dear former pupil. We'd love you to present the prizes at Prize Day. Mr Hargreaves (PE) says he 'always knew'. He did not always know.

choices.label: Present the prizes (uses a time slot)
choices.result: Mr Hargreaves calls you 'my lad'. Your old maths teacher asks for a selfie. Revenge tastes like Ribena.

news.headline: HEAD OF THE CLASS: {NAME} BACK AT SCHOOL

choices.label: Too busy, sorry
choices.result: They get the local weatherman instead. He's thrilled.

events.text: Sid Scoop. I'll write you a lovely puff piece. 'Wonderkid', the works. All I need is the team for Saturday. Who's playing? Tiny thing. Nobody gets hurt.

choices.label: Leak the team
choices.result: Sid sends you £200 in an envelope that smells of pickled onions.

choices.label: Tell Sid where to go
choices.result: 'You'll regret that,' says Sid. You suspect he's right.

events.text: Somebody leaked my team to Sid Scoop. I've narrowed it down to you, Gaz and the bloke who does the pies. The pie bloke can't read. And Gaz can't spell 'team'.

choices.label: Confess
choices.result: He doesn't shout. That's worse. He just sighs, like a slow puncture.

choices.label: Blame the pie bloke
choices.result: The pie bloke is sacked. The pies are worse now. Everyone knows.

events.text: I won again on you, pet! I've bought you a present. It's a gold chain. It's very big. It says your name. In diamonds. Well, nearly diamonds.

choices.label: Wear it with pride
choices.result: It weighs more than your boots. The lads call you Mr T.

news.headline: BLING IT ON: {NAME}'S GRAN GOES FOR GOLD

choices.label: Thank her, hide it in a drawer
choices.result: Gran checks every photo of you for the chain. Every. Photo.

events.text: Love, the club nutritionist rang. She says you've been living on Pot Noodles. I've booked you a cooking class with Auntie Carol. Thursday. It's non-negotiable. x

choices.label: Go to the cooking class (uses a time slot)
choices.result: You learn three meals. Two involve sherry.

choices.label: Order a Deliveroo instead
choices.result: Your Deliveroo rider recognises you and asks why you're always ordering chicken nuggets at 11pm.

events.text: Congratulations! You've been voted Supporters' Player of the Month! The award ceremony is at the Working Men's Club. There'll be a buffet. A big one.

choices.label: Go and give a speech
choices.result: You thank your mum, your gran and the buffet. Standing ovation.

choices.label: Send a video message
choices.result: The video plays sideways. Everyone watches it sideways.

events.text: A bloke in the car park shouts 'Get a proper striker!' at you. His mate shouts 'Or a proper haircut!' Then they ask for an autograph for their kid.

choices.label: Sign it, and smile
choices.result: 'You're alright, you,' says the first bloke. Progress.

choices.label: Tell them what you think of them
choices.result: Someone films it. It's not your best angle.

news.headline: CAR PARK CLASH: {NAME} BLOWS HIS TOP

events.text: Tony here. Super-agent. Lunch. My treat. Steakhouse. I've got contacts in Dubai, Madrid and a bloke in Rhyl. Sign nothing, just eat.

choices.label: Go to lunch
choices.result: Tony orders for you, takes a photo of you, and leaves you with the bill. £180.

choices.label: Ignore him
choices.result: Tony sends you 14 voice notes. One is just him chewing.

events.text: Sid Scoop. Funny photo landed on my desk: you, a steakhouse, and Tony 'Ten Percent' Malone. Are you leaving the club?

choices.label: 'No comment'
choices.result: 'No comment' means yes in newspaper.

choices.label: 'I love this club'
choices.result: Sid prints it anyway, with a photo of you holding a steak knife.

events.text: Dennis grabs your arm in the corridor. 'Tuesday. A seagull. Don't eat the sausage roll.' He walks off. On Tuesday a seagull steals your sausage roll. Dennis winks at you from across the car park.

choices.label: Ask Dennis what else he knows
choices.result: 'You'll be famous,' he says. 'Or infamous. Depends on the slippers.' What slippers?

choices.label: Back away slowly
choices.result: You start checking for seagulls everywhere. There are always seagulls.
